data_fields.name: condition_decay_per_day
data_fields.donor_constant: reliability_spd_dec per engine model (value not read)

data_fields.name: decay_doubling_at_year_starts
data_fields.donor_constant: shift left once at each of 5 year starts after max age

data_fields.name: risk_increment
data_fields.donor_constant: +1 per roll, +25 on a 1-in-25 roll, cap 255

data_fields.name: softer_setting_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: 0x6666 added to reliability for the roll under Reduced

data_fields.name: service_interval_days
data_fields.donor_constant: 150 trains and road vehicles, 100 aircraft, 360 ships (days); min 30, max 800 (days)

best_idea: A per-unit condition that decays each day, with a risk roll from a banded table plus a non-resetting accumulator that makes back-to-back events less likely, and a full restore at the hub that cuts the accumulator.
decision_why: The decay, banded risk with accumulator, timed sideline and hub service fit between-bout fatigue and recovery as engine state; the donor's mid-trip stop does not fit a fighter, so it is rejected and the event is applied between bouts, with the age doubling capped rather than wrapped.
acceptance: In a server test over 20 simulated days with no service, condition falls by its decay each day and at least one event is rolled and recorded with its roll value; an event sidelines the fighter for 128 to 255 units; a service sets condition to maximum and cuts the risk accumulator to a quarter.
